blockdesc-largepot-copper-*: Cooks up to 8 servings at once.
blockdesc-largepot-tinbronze-*: Cooks up to 10 servings at once.
blockdesc-largepot-iron-*: Cooks up to 12 servings at once.
fuel-notlit: {0} - light it with a firestarter or torch
kiln-molten: Molten metal - pour into a mould
smoke-choking: You're choking on smoke! Open the room up or add a chimney.
vent-smoky: Smoky! No chimney in a closed room (works 40% slower)
vent-choking: Room is full of smoke - it will hurt anyone inside!
blockdesc-stovepipe: Joins up automatically. Run it from a Kitchen Range, Kiln Oven or clay oven to a Clay Brick Chimney (draft bonus) or out through a wall to open air, so a closed room doesn't fill with smoke. Optional - stoves work without it.
stovepipe-handbook-text: A fire in a closed room with no way out for the smoke fills the room with smoke and chokes anyone inside. Vent it by: putting a Clay Brick Chimney straight above it (up to 8 blocks), running stovepipes from it to a Clay Brick Chimney, or running stovepipes out of the room into open air. A chimney also gives a draft that makes the fire work 25% faster.
blockdesc-kitchenrange-copper-*: Cooks on 1 plate, a tiny bit faster than a firepit. Takes a pot of food or a single food item on each plate. It has no oven. Burns firewood, charcoal or coal.
blockdesc-kilnoven-copper-*: Fires 2 raw clay items at once in about 12 in-game hours (6 with charcoal): tool molds, ingot molds, pots and other pottery. Needs fuel that burns at 650°C or more for molds. Reaches 1100°C, enough to melt copper and every bronze in a crucible - needs charcoal or coal for that.
blockdesc-kitchenrange-tinbronze-*: Cooks on 2 plates, a bit faster than a firepit. Takes a pot of food or a single food item on each plate. Its oven bakes 1 item at a time. Burns firewood, charcoal or coal.
blockdesc-kilnoven-tinbronze-*: Fires 3 raw clay items at once in about 10 in-game hours (5 with charcoal): tool molds, ingot molds, pots and other pottery. Needs fuel that burns at 650°C or more for molds. Runs 10% hotter than its fuel, up to 1475°C: with coke it melts nickel (1325°C) in a crucible.
blockdesc-kitchenrange-iron-*: Cooks on 3 plates, faster than a firepit. Takes a pot of food or a single food item on each plate. Its oven bakes 2 items at a time. Burns firewood, charcoal or coal.
blockdesc-kilnoven-iron-*: Fires 4 raw clay items at once in about 8 in-game hours (4 with charcoal): tool molds, ingot molds, pots and other pottery. Needs fuel that burns at 650°C or more for molds. Runs 25% hotter than its fuel, up to 1700°C: with coke it reaches iron (1482°C) and titanium (1668°C) heat.
blockdesc-kitchenrange-steel-*: Cooks on 4 plates, the fastest of all. Takes a pot of food or a single food item on each plate. Its oven bakes 3 items at a time. Burns firewood, charcoal or coal.
blockdesc-kilnoven-steel-*: Fires 5 raw clay items at once in about 6 in-game hours (3 with charcoal): tool molds, ingot molds, pots and other pottery. Needs fuel that burns at 650°C or more for molds. Runs 45% hotter than its fuel, up to 1950°C: with coke it reaches chromium (1907°C) heat.
blockdesc-retort-copper-*: Burns firewood and logs without air to make charcoal, and black or brown coal to make coke. Needs fuel to heat it. Joins to stovepipes and chimneys like a stove, and makes a lot more smoke than other stoves, so vent it well when indoors.
blockdesc-retort-tinbronze-*: Burns firewood and logs without air to make charcoal, and black or brown coal to make coke. Needs fuel to heat it. Joins to stovepipes and chimneys like a stove, and makes a lot more smoke than other stoves, so vent it well when indoors.
blockdesc-retort-iron-*: Burns firewood and logs without air to make charcoal, and black or brown coal to make coke. Needs fuel to heat it. Joins to stovepipes and chimneys like a stove, and makes a lot more smoke than other stoves, so vent it well when indoors.
blockdesc-retort-steel-*: Burns firewood and logs without air to make charcoal, and black or brown coal to make coke. Needs fuel to heat it. Joins to stovepipes and chimneys like a stove, and makes a lot more smoke than other stoves, so vent it well when indoors.
